_why: How much each era counts toward Rokugan's price of every good (feature 223). An era not named weighs 1. The GM sets these: 'how representative we think they are of our setting' (2026-10-25). The Chinese eras weigh 1 by the GM's ruling (2026-10-25: Rokugan is geographically more like China than Japan, so China is as valid as Japan for these weights). Meiji Tokyo 1882 is still open (GM on the fence: better figures, but after the opening); its cloth and lamp oil sit outside every Tokugawa era's range. Rice is the anchor and does not move; only goods priced beside rice in an era count there.
